responsibility: This target header supplies the ELF-specific driver and object-format configuration for the H8/300 port. It overrides startfile/endfile and linker specs, sets the user label prefix and jump-table placement policy for PIC, and selects the correct emulation names for H8/300H, H8S, and H8SX ELF linkers, making it the ABI/environment companion to the generic h8300 target definitions rather than the core code-generation logic.
